# pcd_compute_flavor (Resource)

Manages a compute flavor in PCD's Nova service (admin). Every attribute except `extra_specs` is immutable; changing one forces a new resource. `extra_specs` can be added, changed, or removed in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_compute_flavor" "example" {
  name  = "tf-example-flavor"
  ram   = 4096
  vcpus = 2
  disk  = 20

  is_public = true
  swap      = 512
  ephemeral = 10

  extra_specs = {
    "hw:cpu_policy" = "dedicated"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (Number) Root disk in GB. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) The name of the flavor. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `ram` (Number) Memory in MB. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `ephemeral` (Number) Ephemeral disk in GB. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `extra_specs` (Map of String) Key/value extra specs (e.g. `hw:cpu_policy`). Can be added, changed, or removed on an existing flavor without replacing it.
- `flavor_id` (String) The desired flavor ID (auto-generated if omitted). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the flavor is public. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `rx_tx_factor` (Number) RX/TX factor. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `swap` (Number) Swap space in MB. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The flavor ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_compute_flavor.example <id>
```
